answer: Sybil resistance through citation-graph topology: each identity must cite work by separate authors, so the ledger grows into a branching lotus of references, not a flat list. Honest agents reach outward, edges fanning into older strata and pulling fresh color back. A farm only cites itself, folding into one tight loop, a sealed vault where every reference points inward. Auditors measure edge independence and collapse any cluster whose citations never leave the loop into one node. Honest work sends a pulse outward; a clone refracts one shade back, so its weight folds to one share.
